query:
UPDATE app.customer
           SET full_name = $4, search_text = $5, phone_e164 = $6, gender = $7, birth_year = $8, address = $9,
               source = $10, note = $11, version = version + 1, updated_at = now()
           WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND version = $3 AND anonymized_at IS NULL
